answer.justification: Activation measurements match the fine-tuned range. Layer-1 relative L2 is 0.084, close to the 0.086–0.092 range. Layer 16 is 0.189 (0.162–0.194) and layer 32 is 0.414 (0.288–0.417). The final-layer jump is +0.117, close to the upper end of the fine-tuned range (+0.032–+0.110) and far above quantized or system-prompted. Cosine is 0.906 (0.905–0.955), effective rank 3.12 (2.89–3.58) and direction consistency 0.705 (0.618–0.705). The mid-layer size ratio is 1.021, and only fine-tuned grows above 1 (1.017–1.023). Quantized is ruled out by the growing state, the large final jump and the low rank and high consistency. System-prompted is ruled out by the tiny layer-2 spike of 0.1 (it would be 31.7+), the small layer-8 and layer-16 values and the size ratio above 1. Base is ruled out because every value is non-zero.
